summary.text: Fred Price Jr. is the Republican candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 47A, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 23, 2026, and was the Republican nominee for Maryland State Senate District 47 in 2018.

paragraphs.text: Fred Price Jr. won the Republican primary for Maryland State Senate District 47 on June 26, 2018, receiving 266 votes in an uncontested primary.
In the November 6, 2018 general election, Democrat Malcolm Augustine defeated Price, 93.0 percent to 6.9 percent.
Price advanced from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary for House of Delegates District 47A.
